item.title: Big Four News Apps Erase Don Lemon’s Grand Jury Indictment
item.description: Big Four News Apps Erase Don Lemon’s Grand Jury Indictment EXCLUSIVE: Former CNN anchor-turned-YouTuber Don Lemon was shielded at nearly every level following his federal indictment tied to the Cities Church riot. Elitist media outlets downplayed the charges, and like clockwork, Apple News, Google News, MSN and Yahoo News hopped in to finish the job.
